summary: Middle East conflict (Iran/UAE) is the primary market mover, causing oil spike May 4. S&P 500 fell 0.41% to 7,200.75, Dow fell 1.13% to 48,941.90 on geopolitical tensions. Other flashpoints: US-Venezuela, NATO/Greenland, tariff uncertainty, Fed leadership transition, US midterm elections. IMF warns global economy tested again.
